title: Sphere Encoder 2
headline: Improving Sphere Encoder: Bridging Latent Sphere Gaps for Better One-Step Image Generation
tldr: The Sphere Encoder 2 paper addresses two key limitations of the original model: the concentration of latent points near the equator and the incomplete training rotation. By correcting these gaps, the model achieves higher quality, one-step image generation.
significance: This work enhances autoencoder-based generative models, enabling more reliable and high-fidelity image synthesis from latent spheres.

title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
headline: Fast Real-Time Avatar Animation via Gaussian Blendshape Distillation
tldr: We show that pretrained 3D Gaussian avatars can be animated efficiently by approximating them with a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Our GALA method distills neural inference into a lightweight linear model, enabling real-time avatar animation without sacrificing visual quality.
significance: This approach dramatically reduces computational cost, making high-fidelity avatar animation feasible on consumer hardware.

title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
headline: KaliBench: Benchmarking LLM-Generated Cybersecurity Commands on Kali Linux Without Runtime Overhead
tldr: KaliBench introduces a fine-grained benchmark that evaluates LLMs on their ability to produce executable Kali Linux tool commands. The dataset includes runtime-free verifiable rewards, enabling objective measurement of tool invocation accuracy.
significance: This benchmark bridges the gap between knowledge-based LLM evaluation and real-world cybersecurity tool usage, providing a practical metric for operational readiness.

title: ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
headline: Evaluating Visual Fidelity of Programmable World Models in Next-Gen Game Engines
tldr: Programmable world models separate dynamics from visual rendering, but their adherence to program rules is under-tested. This study introduces a benchmark to assess fine-grained visual fidelity in game engine contexts.
significance: The benchmark provides a systematic way to ensure that visual outputs match explicit program specifications, advancing reliable game engine development.

title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
headline: Predicting Embeddings Boosts Diffusion Transformer Image Generation for High-Resolution Visuals
tldr: NEPA trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding, allowing the model to use predicted embeddings as conditioning during denoising. This reduces reliance on a fixed prompt and improves image generation quality and flexibility.
significance: By enabling dynamic conditioning, NEPA enhances diffusion models' adaptability and opens new avenues for controllable image synthesis.

title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
headline: ScholarCatalyst: Benchmarking Retrieval of Inspiring Papers for New Scientific Research
tldr: ScholarCatalyst introduces a benchmark that evaluates AI systems' ability to retrieve prior papers that directly inspire new research, using curated datasets from researchers who cite foundational works. The benchmark highlights the gap between current AI retrieval models and human expertise in recognizing relevant scientific lineage.
significance: It provides a rigorous test for AI systems to emulate the human skill of spotting pivotal prior research, crucial for accelerating scientific discovery.

title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
headline: SILSA: Sliding-Window Latents Preserve Topology for High-Res 3D Generation
tldr: SILSA introduces a sliding-window slice latent approach that maintains surface continuity while reducing token fragmentation in voxel-based 3D generation. By preserving topology, it lowers computational cost and improves fidelity for thin or highly connected shapes.
significance: This method enables more efficient, topologically consistent high-resolution 3D models, advancing realistic synthetic geometry creation.

title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
headline: VISTA: Enabling Long-Horizon Vision for Multimodal Reasoning in Interactive Environments
tldr: We demonstrate that multimodal models can excel at reasoning when provided with a visual harness that offers long-horizon vision. VISTA allows these models to directly perceive and process visual observations in interactive environments, unlocking their potential across diverse tasks.
significance: VISTA bridges the gap between general-purpose multimodal models and complex interactive tasks, enabling more robust reasoning capabilities.

title: TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning
headline: TACO: Memory-Efficient Optimizer for Full-Parameter LLM Fine-Tuning, Reducing GPU Memory Footprint
tldr: TACO introduces a ternary absolute-max column-wise one-sparse optimizer that dramatically cuts optimizer state memory for full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models. By leveraging sparse updates, it enables training larger models on existing GPUs without sacrificing convergence speed.
significance: This work lowers the barrier to fine-tuning massive LLMs, making it feasible on commodity hardware and accelerating research.

title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
headline: FERPO: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning with Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Updates
tldr: FERPO introduces a novel entropy-regularized policy optimization that leverages forward action gradients, addressing inaccuracies in critic-derived gradients. The method improves stability and performance in continuous control tasks compared to existing gradient-based RL algorithms.
significance: By ensuring more reliable policy updates, FERPO advances the robustness of online RL in continuous control, potentially benefiting robotics and autonomous systems.

title: HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation
headline: Physically Plausible Video Generation with Hierarchical Alignment for Multi‑Principle Scenarios
tldr: HiPhy introduces a hierarchical alignment framework that enforces multiple physical laws in video generation, enabling realistic simulations of complex interactions like buoyancy and gravity. The model demonstrates improved physical plausibility while maintaining high visual fidelity on benchmark datasets.
significance: This work bridges the gap between visual realism and physical accuracy, paving the way for reliable AI‑driven simulations in science and entertainment.

title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
headline: InterEvolve: Adapting Humanoid Controllers at Test Time for New Loco-Manipulation Tasks
tldr: We demonstrate that a pre-trained humanoid controller can be repurposed for unseen tasks by evolving its reward program during deployment. This approach improves performance without retraining and retains learned skills.
significance: This method enables rapid deployment of versatile humanoid robots in dynamic environments without costly retraining.

title: Geospatial & AI Trends: Highlights from 2025 - Geoawesome
headline: 2025 GeoAI Trends: Predictive Insights, Automation, and Climate Solutions for Cities and Global Challenges
tldr: In 2025, GeoAI leverages foundation models and real-time satellite imagery to forecast climate impacts and optimize urban planning. These advancements enable faster decision-making across agriculture, disaster response, and infrastructure management.
significance: These trends transform how governments and businesses anticipate and mitigate environmental risks, driving smarter, data‑driven policy.

title: GeoAI | Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Work with AI-Driven Feature Extraction and Predictive Analytics
tldr: Artificial intelligence is transforming geospatial workflows by automating feature extraction from imagery and point clouds, and enabling predictive analysis across the data pipeline. These advances unlock new applications in urban planning, environmental monitoring, and disaster response.
significance: By integrating AI with large-scale spatial data, GeoAI accelerates decision-making and opens up real-time, data-driven insights for a wide range of industries.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Charting the Future of GeoAI: Emerging Trends and Next-Gen Innovations
tldr: GeoAI merges geospatial science with AI, rapidly evolving as a leading field in spatial data science. This paper reviews recent advances and projects future directions to guide researchers and practitioners.
significance: Understanding GeoAI's trajectory is crucial for leveraging AI to solve spatial challenges across environmental, urban, and societal domains.

title: GeoAI and the Next Generation of Geospatial Insights - Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Insights: AI, Data, and Sensors Converge for Smarter Mapping
tldr: Artificial intelligence is reshaping geospatial analysis by integrating data, sensing technologies, and AI-driven insights. This GeoAI shift promises faster, more accurate mapping and decision-making across industries.
significance: GeoAI will transform how organizations capture, analyze, and act on spatial information, enabling smarter, data-driven decisions.

title: Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) Is Widening the Digital ...
headline: GeoAI Expands Digital Divide: Data Sovereignty, Power, and Literacy Gaps Grow
tldr: GeoAI merges AI with spatial data, offering powerful insights but also deepening inequities in data control, computational resources, and essential literacy. The concentration of GeoAI capabilities risks widening the digital divide beyond mere access.
significance: Understanding GeoAI's inequity risks is crucial for equitable technology deployment and policy.

title: remote-sensing · GitHub Topics · GitHub
headline: Remote Sensing Change Detection: Datasets, Tools, Methods, and Competitions Hub
tldr: This GitHub topic aggregates up-to-date datasets, tools, and research for detecting changes in remote sensing imagery. It also highlights competitions and review papers to support practitioners and researchers.
significance: It serves as a central resource accelerating progress in change detection across environmental and urban monitoring.

title: GeoAI: Artificial Intelligence for Geospatial Data - GitHub
headline: GeoAI Toolkit: Streamlined Satellite Imagery Access & AI-ready Dataset Generation
tldr: GeoAI provides easy access to Sentinel, Landsat, NAIP, and other open datasets, automating download, mosaicking, preprocessing, and generating labeled image chips for AI tasks. Its vector-to-raster utilities and data augmentation tools streamline the creation of high-quality training data for segmentation and object detection models.
significance: By simplifying remote sensing data workflows, GeoAI accelerates AI research and deployment in geospatial applications.

title: Home - GeoAI
headline: GeoAI: A Python Package Uniting AI with Geospatial Data Analysis and Visualization
tldr: GeoAI is a Python library that seamlessly integrates machine learning models into geospatial workflows, enabling tasks like segmentation, object detection, and change detection on satellite imagery. It offers intuitive APIs, visualization tools, and supports open‑source data formats for researchers and practitioners.
significance: GeoAI democratizes advanced AI techniques for geospatial analysis, accelerating insights across environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster response.

title: Open Source Software - The Geological Remote Sensing Group (GRSG)
headline: GRSG: A Free, Open-Source Suite for Advanced Optical, SAR, and Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
tldr: The Geological Remote Sensing Group (GRSG) aggregates free geospatial software and libraries for comprehensive remote sensing. It enables advanced image processing across optical, multispectral, SAR, and hyperspectral data for researchers and professionals.
significance: GRSG democratizes cutting‑edge remote‑sensing capabilities by providing a unified, open‑source toolkit that supports diverse datasets and advanced analytics.

title: Raster Vision: An open-source machine learning library for deep ...
headline: Raster Vision: Open-Source Library Bridging GIS and Deep Learning for Remote Sensing
tldr: Raster Vision offers a configurable computer vision pipeline tailored for geospatial tasks such as chip classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection. Its open-source design enables researchers and practitioners to integrate GIS data with deep learning models seamlessly.
significance: By unifying GIS workflows with state-of-the-art deep learning, Raster Vision accelerates the development of scalable, reproducible geospatial AI solutions.

title: 13 Open Source Remote Sensing Software Packages
headline: Explore 13 Free Remote Sensing Tools for Satellite Image Analysis
tldr: This article lists 13 open‑source software packages that support satellite imagery processing, from basic GIS tools to advanced machine‑learning frameworks. Each entry highlights its core strengths, typical use cases, and installation guidance.
significance: Open‑source remote sensing software empowers researchers and practitioners to conduct cost‑effective, reproducible geospatial analyses.

title: Probing the Reionization History and Bubble Sizes with JWST Lyman-$α$ Fraction Measurements
headline: JWST Ly‑α Fractions Reveal Reionization Bubble Sizes
tldr: JWST observations of Ly‑α emission from galaxies at z~6–14 show a declining fraction of detectable lines, indicating increasing neutral hydrogen in the IGM. These measurements constrain the timing and patchiness of cosmic reionization, providing estimates of bubble sizes around early galaxies.
significance: This study offers the first direct probe of reionization topology using JWST, refining models of early galaxy formation and the intergalactic medium.

title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
headline: Multimodal Flow: Continuous Generative Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
tldr: Multimodal Flow introduces a continuous generative framework that jointly models language and vision without quantization bottlenecks. By operating entirely in embedding space, it eliminates modality-specific objectives and sampling, enabling more seamless multimodal generation.
significance: This approach removes the need for discrete tokenization and modality-dependent training, paving the way for more efficient and unified multimodal foundation models.

title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
headline: Optimizing Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis with Ranking‑Aware Prompting for AUROC in Healthcare
tldr: We propose a ranking‑aware prompt optimization framework that directly optimizes AUROC for multimodal large language models in clinical diagnosis. This approach mitigates class imbalance and improves the clinical utility of predictions compared to accuracy‑centric pipelines.
significance: By focusing on AUROC, the method ensures better ranking of true positives, directly benefiting high‑stakes medical decision‑making.

title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
headline: Semifactual Prompt Interventions Expose Token Sensitivity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
tldr: We apply semifactual prompt interventions to RLVR, preserving the problem while altering irrelevant prompt features. Our analysis uncovers substantial token-level sensitivity, indicating that LLM predictions remain fragile to prompt design.
significance: Understanding token-level sensitivity helps improve robustness of LLM-based RL systems.

title: Removing Timing Shortcuts Improves Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
headline: Eliminating Timing Biases Enhances Accuracy of Brain-to-Text Decoding Without Brain Data
tldr: Researchers show that the impressive gains in decoding spoken words from non-invasive brain recordings can be largely reproduced using only the timing of the words, without any neural data. Removing these timing shortcuts reveals that the neural network's performance is largely driven by linguistic priors rather than genuine neural signals.
significance: This finding challenges the validity of recent brain‑to‑text breakthroughs and underscores the need for rigorous controls in neural decoding research.

title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
headline: Physis‑Lang: Self‑Evolving Language for Physical Video World Models
tldr: The paper introduces Physis‑Lang, a language representation that evolves to encode physical dynamics, enabling video world models to generate physically consistent predictions without extra visual or latent cues. Experiments show improved adherence to physics while maintaining visual realism.
significance: By embedding physics directly into language, Physis‑Lang reduces reliance on auxiliary signals and advances physically grounded video generation.

title: Singularity of harmonic measures for hyperbolic lattices
headline: Singularity of Harmonic Measures for Hyperbolic Lattices: Random Walks on Convex Subgroups
tldr: The paper proves that for a cocompact lattice in hyperbolic space containing a convex cocompact codimension‑one subgroup, any finitely supported admissible random walk has a hitting measure that is singular with respect to Lebesgue measure on the sphere at infinity. This extends Kosenko–Tiozzo’s method by replacing Fourier analysis with geometric arguments.
significance: It establishes a new rigidity phenomenon for harmonic measures on hyperbolic lattices, deepening our understanding of random walks in negatively curved spaces.

title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
headline: ViTeX-Bench: Evaluating High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing for Real-World Applications
tldr: ViTeX-Bench introduces a comprehensive benchmark for assessing video scene text editing models, focusing on preserving scene dynamics while replacing on-surface text. The dataset includes diverse real-world scenarios and evaluation metrics that capture visual fidelity, motion consistency, and edit realism.
significance: This benchmark enables systematic comparison of video editing approaches, accelerating progress toward realistic, controllable video manipulation.

title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
headline: AssemblyWorld: Evaluating General-Purpose Agents for 3D Object Assembly in Interactive Environments
tldr: We introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment that tests whether pretrained general-purpose agents can assemble objects from visual input without task-specific fine-tuning. Our experiments show that while agents can perform basic manipulations, they struggle with complex spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for specialized training.
significance: AssemblyWorld provides a benchmark for assessing the spatial reasoning capabilities of foundation models in physically grounded tasks.

title: Efficient Calculation of Equilibrium Correlation Functions
headline: Quantum Algorithms for Fast Equilibrium Correlation Functions: A New Approach to Dynamic Quantities
tldr: This paper introduces a novel quantum algorithm that efficiently computes equilibrium correlation functions, reducing resource overhead compared to traditional Hamiltonian simulation methods. The approach leverages linear-response theory and offers potential speedups for time-series analysis in quantum systems.
significance: It provides a scalable method for evaluating key dynamical observables in quantum many-body systems, accelerating research in condensed matter and quantum chemistry.

title: Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners
headline: VideoMSN: Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation via Masked Siamese Vision Transformers
tldr: VideoMSN repurposes image Vision Transformers to learn video representations by treating videos as super images, enabling efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal learning without heavy 3D models. The framework achieves competitive performance while reducing computational cost, making it suitable for large-scale, unlabeled video datasets.
significance: This approach democratizes video representation learning by leveraging lightweight image models, lowering barriers to entry for researchers and practitioners.

title: Resonances control when multiterminal Josephson currents reduce to two-terminal couplings
headline: Resonances Determine When Multiterminal Josephson Currents Reduce to Two-Terminal Couplings
tldr: The study compares pairwise two‑terminal models with genuine multiterminal processes in Josephson junctions, revealing that resonant conditions dictate when the simpler pairwise description suffices. This insight helps identify when reduced models accurately capture the physics of complex superconducting networks.
significance: It clarifies the limits of reduced models for designing superconducting circuits, aiding accurate simulation of multiterminal devices.

title: Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts
headline: Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning via Point Prompts for Complete Shape Coverage
tldr: Point2Part introduces a novel approach to 3D part decomposition using point prompts, ensuring non-overlapping, fully covering partitions. This method improves downstream part-level tasks by eliminating gaps and overlaps present in prior techniques.
significance: By guaranteeing complete, non-overlapping partitions, Point2Part enhances the reliability of part-based analysis for 3D models, benefiting applications from CAD to robotics.

title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
headline: Robots Self-Improve on the Fly Using Foundation Models for Autonomous Policy Refinement
tldr: This work demonstrates how robots can autonomously refine their policies in real-world environments by leveraging foundation models, reducing the need for human demonstrations. The approach scales across tasks, enabling continuous learning from new situations and failures.
significance: By enabling robots to self-improve without human intervention, this method accelerates deployment and adaptability across diverse real-world scenarios.

title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
headline: Teaching MLLMs to Visualize 3D Scenes from Multi‑View Images Before Answering
tldr: The paper introduces Imagine3D‑LLM, a framework that equips multimodal LLMs with 3D reasoning by integrating multi‑view image evidence into a coherent scene representation. Experiments show improved spatial understanding and answer accuracy across benchmark tasks.
significance: It bridges the gap between 2D perception and 3D reasoning in LLMs, enabling more accurate contextual answers.

title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
headline: Exploring Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation in Generative Models and Their Dynamics
tldr: The study identifies two temporal windows in generative model training: a speciation window where samples commit to semantic classes, and a nonlocality window where local context fails. It demonstrates that these windows co‑occur and analyzes their spatial distribution to better understand denoising behavior.
significance: Understanding the interplay between local denoising and semantic commitment can improve generative model design and interpretability.

title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
headline: Simplifying In-Context Robot Learning: A Democratized Approach to Manipulation Tasks
tldr: This paper presents a streamlined framework for robotic in-context learning, enabling robots to infer tasks from visual demonstrations. By disentangling action trajectories, object semantics, and spatial relations, the authors provide an open-source recipe that democratizes manipulation learning for the community.
significance: It offers a practical, open-source solution that lowers the barrier to entry for deploying in-context learning in real-world robotic manipulation.

title: Classification of topological phases of matter in stochastic systems
headline: Classifying Topological Phases in Stochastic Systems: A Markovian Symmetry-Dimension Framework
tldr: Researchers have extended the classification of topological phases to stochastic systems, revealing how Markovian dynamics can support robust edge states. This framework bridges quantum and classical systems, offering new insights into biochemical processes and noise-resistant materials.
significance: This work provides a unified theoretical foundation for understanding noise-protected phenomena in both quantum and classical stochastic environments.

title: Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion
headline: Improving Pixel Diffusion with Adversarial Training for Better Fine-Scale Detail
tldr: Pixel diffusion models generate images directly but often miss fine-scale statistics. Adding adversarial learning after pretraining corrects these deficiencies without altering the original diffusion objective.
significance: This approach enhances pixel diffusion quality, making them competitive with autoencoder-based models while preserving training efficiency.

title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
headline: STEPQuant: Targeted Quantization for Efficient Linear Attention in Real-Time Models
tldr: Linear attention models use recurrent states that grow memory usage during serving. STEPQuant identifies where quantization errors matter and selectively applies low-precision updates, reducing memory without sacrificing accuracy.
significance: This method enables scalable, low-precision deployment of linear attention models in real-time applications.

title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
headline: LeapQuant: Boosting Linear Attention Efficiency via Recurrent State Quantization for LLMs
tldr: LeapQuant introduces a quantization scheme that compresses the recurrent state used in linear attention models, reducing inference overhead while preserving accuracy. The method achieves comparable performance to full-precision models with significantly lower memory and compute costs, making long-context processing more practical.
significance: By efficiently quantizing recurrent states, LeapQuant enables faster, resource‑constrained deployment of large language models with linear attention.

title: Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data
headline: Hybrid Transformer-Convolutional Model Improves Cropland Segmentation in Satellite Time Series
tldr: The paper introduces Cropland PAtteRNS, a hybrid transformer‑convolutional architecture that leverages parallel dimensional attention and dataset‑disparity awareness to enhance cropland segmentation across satellite imagery time series. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate significant gains over state‑of‑the‑art methods while addressing class imbalance and temporal inconsistencies.
significance: It advances crop monitoring by delivering more accurate, temporally consistent segmentation, enabling better resource management and policy decisions.

title: Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models
headline: Rho: Open-Weights VLA Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation
tldr: Rho introduces a family of open-weights Vision-Language-Action models that seamlessly adapt to dual-arm robots across diverse embodiments. The framework enables data-light task adaptation, bridging broad visual and linguistic understanding with precise robotic control.
significance: Rho provides a scalable foundation for versatile, low-data robotics applications, accelerating deployment across research and industry.

title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
headline: ReWAM: Rethinking Representation Spaces for Joint Policy Learning and Prediction
tldr: World-action models link robot control with future observation prediction via a shared representation space. This study shows that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone guarantee effective policy learning, leading to ReWAM, a representation‑centric framework that balances these aspects.
significance: This work provides a principled approach to designing representation spaces that simultaneously support control and prediction, improving the effectiveness of world-action models.

title: A Spectral Theory of Distortion in LLM Graph Reconstruction: Sharp Bounds and Empirical Characterization
headline: Spectral Bounds for Graph Reconstruction Errors in LLMs
tldr: The study proves that the Wasserstein distance between Laplacian spectra of original and reconstructed graphs is tightly bounded by two edge-count metrics, offering a sharper diagnostic than a single aggregate distance. This theoretical result also provides an empirical framework for evaluating LLM-generated graph structures.
significance: It gives a principled way to quantify and bound graph reconstruction errors in language models, improving interpretability and benchmarking.

title: From Density to Mass: A New Parametrized Framework for Dark Matter Environment Around Black Holes
headline: Parametrized Dark Matter Halo Models Reveal New Black Hole Gravitational Wave Signatures
tldr: We introduce a parametrized framework linking dark matter density profiles to black hole mass distributions, enabling predictions of modified quasinormal modes and tidal Love numbers. This approach offers a new tool for interpreting gravitational-wave observations and probing dark matter environments around astrophysical black holes.
significance: The framework provides a systematic method to quantify how dark matter halos alter black hole spacetime, enhancing the interpretability of gravitational-wave data.

title: FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
headline: FurE: Fast, Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction Without Dedicated Datasets for Animals
tldr: FurE reconstructs realistic animal fur from multi-view images using a strand-based approach that does not rely on large animal-fur datasets. The method achieves high detail and editability while remaining computationally efficient.
significance: It enables realistic fur modeling for diverse animal species without costly dataset collection, advancing digital content creation and scientific visualization.

title: Telescopic Language Models
headline: Telescopic Language Models: A Continuum of Transformer Capacities for Flexible Compute Budgets
tldr: We introduce Telescopic Language Models (TLMs), nested-capacity Transformers trained with stochastic prefix supervision. This design allows a single model to serve a continuum of compute budgets, eliminating the need for separate training or compression for each target capacity.
significance: TLMs provide a scalable, efficient solution for deploying language models across diverse hardware constraints, reducing training overhead and resource consumption.

title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
headline: PDMD: Reducing Video Diffusion Evaluations with Projected Distribution Matching Distillation
tldr: PDMD cuts the number of denoising steps needed for video diffusion models from dozens to just a few, while addressing training instability caused by critic errors. By projecting distribution matching onto the student updates, it stabilizes training and preserves visual quality.
significance: This method enables faster, more stable video diffusion inference, making high‑quality video generation more practical.

title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
headline: Unified Models Learn to Reflect and Repair Their Own Image Generation
tldr: Unified multimodal models can diagnose and revise their own image outputs, learning the process jointly through interleaved reinforcement learning. This approach enables self-improvement of generation quality without external supervision.
significance: It demonstrates a path toward self-correcting generative models that can iteratively refine outputs, reducing reliance on human feedback.

title: Retrieving Biblical Intertextual References in Karen Blixen's Seven Gothic Tales
headline: Computational Retrieval of Biblical Intertextuality in Blixen's Seven Gothic Tales
tldr: The study builds a benchmark of 189 annotated biblical references in Karen Blixen's Seven Gothic Tales and applies large language models to detect intertextual allusions despite paraphrase and translation. It demonstrates the feasibility of automated literary intertextuality detection and offers a resource for future computational literary scholarship.
significance: This work provides the first computational benchmark for biblical intertextuality in Blixen's prose, enabling large-scale literary analysis and advancing NLP methods for nuanced textual comparison.

title: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose
headline: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Accurate Lower-Body 3D Pose
tldr: A new benchmark demonstrates that fusing earbud head IMUs with smart-insole foot IMUs yields reliable lower-body 3D pose estimates, even with consumer sensor drift and mounting variability. The study introduces a reliability-gated fusion strategy that mitigates firmware bias and stream dropouts.
significance: This work enables robust, camera-free motion capture using inexpensive consumer wearables, paving the way for scalable human motion analytics.

title: Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation
headline: One-Step Visual Generation via Unified Distributional Training
tldr: The authors propose a unified theoretical framework that separates distribution modeling from discrepancy matching in frozen representation spaces. By linking global objectives to pointwise updates via Wasserstein gradient flow, they achieve efficient one-step visual generation.
significance: It offers a principled, efficient approach to train generative models with minimal steps, potentially accelerating real-time image synthesis.

title: Peppy: An AI-Assisted Workflow for Tight Convergence Analysis of Optimization Algorithms
headline: Peppy: AI Workflow for Tight Convergence Proofs in First-Order Optimization
tldr: Peppy uses domain-specific knowledge and large language models to automatically generate tight, analytic convergence proofs for first-order optimization algorithms. By integrating with formal proof assistants, it streamlines the research workflow and reduces manual effort.
significance: Peppy advances automated mathematical research by delivering precise convergence guarantees that were previously labor-intensive to obtain.

title: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
headline: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation via Egocentric Human Demonstrations
tldr: DexRoam learns mobile bimanual manipulation by leveraging egocentric whole-body human demonstrations, preserving fine-grained coordination of locomotion, posture, and finger dexterity. The method enables robots to acquire complex, continuous trajectories without simplifying human motion.
significance: This approach addresses the demonstration bottleneck in mobile manipulation, enabling robots to learn intricate, coupled motions directly from human data.

title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
headline: Predicting Token Usage in LLM Agents: A New Forecasting Approach
tldr: Token consumption by LLM agents can vary by an order of magnitude across runs, making cost estimation difficult. TokenCast introduces a forecasting model that predicts total token usage before execution, enabling better budgeting and resource planning.
significance: Accurate token prediction reduces operational costs and improves scalability of LLM-driven applications.

title: Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control
headline: Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control
tldr: We propose a hard-EM framework that learns contractive dynamical representations to improve composite adaptive tracking control under coupled disturbances. By integrating a Kalman smoother into the hard-EM loop, the method achieves statistically principled disturbance rejection and enhanced tracking performance.
significance: This approach bridges classical disturbance accommodation with modern adaptive learning, enabling more robust real-time control in dynamic environments.
